title: Satwik-Chirag Enter China Masters Semifinals After Thrilling Quarterfinal Win
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, have advanced to the semifinals of a major BWF tournament for the first time since their Singapore Open victory.
summary: India's star men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, battled through a 70-minute thriller against a Danish duo to secure their spot in the China Masters 2026 semifinals.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Announced for Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This course is crucial for enhancing the coaching standards and developing future badminton talent across India.
summary: Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course to be held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14 to 23, 2026.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for Inter State Team Championships 2026
indian_angle: The release of these regulations sets the stage for one of India's premier domestic team events, fostering competition among states.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has issued the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and procedures for participating teams.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships Begins
indian_angle: This camp is vital for preparing India's promising young shuttlers for international competition at the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati.

title: Change in Women's Doubles Pair for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This notification impacts the selection process for India's representation at the prestigious VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant rule change will affect strategy and play in India's domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for junior categories.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has decided to implement the 3x15 scoring system in domestic ranking tournaments and national championships for the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
